cves.note: Insufficiently Protected Credentials: Authorization header forwarded on HTTPS-to-HTTP redirect. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N. Affects <2.20.0; fixed 2.20.0 (2018-10-18). Aliases GHSA-x84v-xcm2-53pg, PYSEC-2018-28.

Proxy-Authorization header leaked to destination on HTTPS via proxy. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N. Affects 2.3.0 to <2.31.0; fixed 2.31.0 (2023-05-22). Aliases GHSA-j8r2-6x86-q33q, PYSEC-2023-74.

dependencies.note: License from PyPI metadata ('Apache 2.0', classifier 'OSI Approved :: Apache Software License'), normalised to SPDX Apache-2.0. Released 2018-06-12; superseded by 2.19.1 two days later and by 2.20.0 on 2018-10-18; latest at time of research is 2.34.2 (2026-05-14). requests publishes no LTS branches or support policy, so 'end-of-life' here means: no 2.19.x line receives fixes and every listed advisory is fixed only in later minor versions. CVE list is the complete OSV result for PyPI requests 2.19.0 (5 advisories, severity mapped MODERATE->medium). Not imported anywhere in src/ (see F-map-ops-030), so runtime exploitability at HEAD is nil; remediation is removing the line, not upgrading. Its declared transitive range urllib3>=1.21.1,<1.24 resolves to urllib3 1.23 (2018), which OSV lists with 11 advisories (5 HIGH); see F-lens-dependencies-004.

dependencies.name: psycopg2
dependencies.note: PyPI metadata says 'LGPL with exceptions' (classifier 'GNU Library or Lesser General Public License (LGPL)'). The SPDX id LGPL-3.0-or-later and the OpenSSL-linking exception are from the researcher's knowledge of psycopg2's LICENSE file, which was NOT fetched; confidence 0.8 on the exact version. Released 2020-09-06 and is the last release of the 2.8 series (confirmed from the PyPI release list); 2.9.0 shipped 2021-06-16 and the current release is 2.9.13 (2026-09-09), so the 2.8 line is end-of-life. Its Python classifiers stop at 3.8 (2.7, 3.4-3.8) while 2.9.13 declares 3.10-3.15. CVEs: OSV returns no advisories for PyPI psycopg2 or psycopg2-binary at ANY version, so the empty list is a real negative result, not 'unknown'. Caveat: psycopg2 links against the system libpq, whose own CVEs are tracked under PostgreSQL, not PyPI; that exposure depends on the host and is unknown from this repository. It is the only dependency actually imported (src/repo/orders_repo.py). No transitive requirements (requires_dist is null).
